hashMethod: SHA-256 of UTF-8 source files in the listed order, joined with a single newline; retain each file's own trailing newline.
scope: Permanent event-based match-simulation baseline, including seeded exhibitions, event-derived statistics and summary briefings. Official competition administration remains separate.
compatibility: Retain the engine version string because it is part of random-seed construction. The exhibition suffix does not mean the adopted source is temporary.
knownLimits: Aggregate contact/foul generation; full bench misconduct, retaliation, offset-foul and escalating-discipline taxonomy is not generated.
Deliberate backwards carries through the opponent's scoring zone and their special restart are not selected by the action policy.
Coaching preferences and disposal decisions are approximate; tested profiles expose substantial sensitivity to winning possession.
Two- and five-minute penalties and the twelve-player floor are v0.1 simulation defaults, not an amendment of the supplied rulebook.
Match fatigue and injuries reset; long-term availability, standings, result commits, scheduling and competition state are not implemented by this core.
changePolicy: Preserve historical seeds, inputs, configurations, engine identity and results. Intentional gameplay changes require an explicit version/compatibility decision, a recorded rationale and appropriate regression/calibration checks. Never silently replace this baseline or reroll saved results.
